items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: we played there many times too, Randy and Buddy P.T. played the heavy bands there all the time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Is that the same clubhouse they have down here now? It doesn't have any building on it. It's open? Oh right now, I'm playing open.

Years back we used to play at the San Suu, you know, you remember the San Suu Hall? Yeah. How about that? Well we played there many times too, Randy and Buddy P.T. played the heavy bands there all the time. That's old time, that's a long time ago you know. That hall's still there.
Yeah but they don't have any more dancers there.
